description: This PHP source file defines a subclass of SugarView called ViewShowDuplicates, which handles displaying a list of duplicate leads in the SuiteCRM application. The class's display method retrieves duplicate lead data, prepares an HTML form with lead details, and renders a template for user interaction when managing duplicate leads.

classes.name: ViewShowDuplicates
classes.description: A subclass of SugarView that manages displaying duplicate lead records and rendering the corresponding user interface for handling duplicates within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Main function responsible for checking session authorization, retrieving duplicate leads from database, preparing form data, and rendering the 'Show Duplicates' template.
